pages.title: Generate Provision Changelog
pages.intent: `litespec-maintain changelog` writes the provision changes since a git ref into the changelog.

pages.title: Generate Provisions
pages.intent: `litespec-maintain provisions` rebuilds the provision index and its data file from the active standards, resolving every identifier to its page, record layer, trace, and checked share. The same run writes the finding code table, the record folder table, and the manifest pin table.

pages.title: Publish a Local Toolchain
pages.intent: `litespec-maintain publish-local` packs the checkout's CLI and analyzers into a local feed and moves a consumer onto that build, or pins the consumer to a CI-published build instead.

pages.title: Validate Standards
pages.intent: `litespec-maintain validate` checks the LiteSpec repository against its own authoring contract.

pages.title: Agent Sync
pages.intent: `litespec agent sync` writes the thin root agent context, the path-scoped rule files, and the hook settings from the project's stacks and selected extensions only.

pages.title: API Explore
pages.intent: `litespec api explore` walks a running API from its OpenAPI document and reports server faults.

pages.title: Audit Semantic
pages.intent: `litespec audit semantic` maps the files changed since a revision to the use cases they touch and writes one review packet per use case.

pages.title: Book Command
pages.intent: `litespec book` - Serve the project book live from memory on localhost, or write it as a static site with `--out`.

pages.title: Context
pages.intent: `litespec context` writes the consumer's records as one compact plain-text file for an AI chat.

pages.title: Docs Review and Render
pages.intent: `litespec docs review` runs the prose lints on the Markdown and record files changed since a revision and writes a review packet an independent reviewer answers. `litespec docs render --changed` re-renders the book pages of only the records whose content hash changed since the last render.

pages.title: Hook
pages.intent: `litespec hook` runs the agent harness hooks: it reminds each file edit with the provisions that govern the file, and it gates the stop on the blocking findings of the change set.

pages.title: Initialize Consumer
pages.intent: `litespec init` starts a consumer repository from a preset: a ready-made selection of shape, stacks, frontends, and layer claims. The `records` preset claims Intent and Behavior only, with no stacks.

pages.title: Model Builder
pages.intent: `litespec model` checks the project model, reviews its prose, formats record files, renders generated outputs, answers record queries, and reports module edges.

pages.title: Scaffold Record
pages.intent: `litespec new` scaffolds a record file, including a requirement's folder, and reserves its identifier. It also appends a result or scenario entry to a use-case file, or a permission entry to its module's permission file.

pages.title: Plan Waves
pages.intent: `litespec plan-waves` prints the conflict-free parallel slices of the consumer, one per aggregate use-case set, with the waves in dependency order.

pages.title: Rename Record
pages.intent: `litespec rename` renames a record identifier and rewrites every link to it.

pages.title: Rules Query
pages.intent: `litespec rules` lists the provisions that govern a path, a record identifier, a change set, or one provision or page identifier, at the record layers the project claims in [layers](../core/scope.md#layer-claims).

pages.title: Scaffold
pages.intent: `litespec scaffold` writes the code files of one use case from its record, into the folders the .NET pack states.

pages.title: Serve
pages.intent: `litespec serve` runs a stdio MCP server over the warm project model: it loads the model once, keeps it warm, and answers the four MCP tools agents use instead of shelling out to `model check` and `rules` on every question.

pages.title: Skill
pages.intent: `litespec skill` installs or removes the litespec skill: the folder of guidance a coding agent loads when its description matches the task.

pages.title: Sync
pages.intent: `litespec sync` writes the pure data the records determine, from the `sync` targets and the frontend clients of the consumer declaration.

pages.title: UI Audit
pages.intent: `litespec ui audit` visits each route of a running application in a browser and reports what the rendered pages show wrong.

pages.title: UI Review
pages.intent: `litespec ui review` lists the screen routes whose files changed since a revision, pairs each with its golden baseline PNGs when present, and writes a review packet an independent reviewer answers.

pages.title: Upgrade Check
pages.intent: `litespec upgrade --check` reports the release changes between the reviewed LiteSpec version of the consumer and the carried release.

pages.title: Verify Persistence Compat
pages.intent: `litespec verify persistence-compat` checks that every stored persistence snapshot still reads through the current serializer.

pages.title: Verify Production Smoke
pages.intent: `litespec verify production-smoke` boots the production containers and probes them.

pages.title: Verify
pages.intent: `litespec verify` runs every scenario probe against the running product and reports each failed expectation.
